title: A shop's lamp brought down
description: In a Weapon shop whose shopkeeper is dead, the player throws a lit bomb up toward the lamp. It goes off under the ceiling and breaks the block the lamp hangs from, and the lamp falls to the floor, a Lamp he can carry.
